@deskSetPrivTorOnFailed.description: Toast title when turning Tor on failed. The error follows as text.

@deskSetPrivTorOffFailed.description: Toast title when turning Tor off failed. The error follows as text.

@deskSetPrivTor.description: Settings > Privacy: title of the Tor group. Tor is a product name.

@deskSetPrivSwitching.description: Screen reader label of the spinner while Tor is switched.

@deskSetPrivTurnOff.description: Settings > Privacy: small button shown when Tor is not connected.

@deskSetPrivNotInBuild.description: Settings > Privacy: Tor state word when this app build has no Tor.

@deskSetPrivStarting.description: Settings > Privacy: Tor state word while it starts.

@deskSetPrivStartingDetail.description: Settings > Privacy: detail of the Tor state while it starts. {progress} is a number 0–100.

deskSetPrivNotPublished: Tor address not published yet. Sends work.

@deskSetPrivNotPublished.description: Settings > Privacy: detail of the Tor state when Tor runs but its receiving address is not published yet.

@deskSetPrivProblemSendsWork.description: Settings > Privacy: detail of the Tor state when Tor runs but receiving has a problem. {problem} is a short sentence from the app without final full stop.

@deskSetPrivConnected.description: Settings > Privacy: detail of the Tor state when everything works.

@deskSetPrivNotConnected.description: Settings > Privacy: Tor state word when Tor could not connect.

deskSetPrivStoppedDetail: Tor stopped. Retry, or turn Tor off.

@deskSetPrivStoppedDetail.description: Settings > Privacy: detail of the Tor state when Tor stopped.

@deskSetPrivProblemDetail.description: Settings > Privacy: detail of the Tor state when Tor failed. {problem} is a short sentence from the app without final full stop.

@deskSetPrivStatusSite.description: Settings > Privacy: title of the group with the status site switch.

@deskSetPrivUseStatus.description: Settings > Privacy: switch title and screen reader name. status.btlabs.uk is a web address and stays.

deskSetPrivUseStatusHint: Shows which nodes and Epicbox servers are online. Only downloads a public list; nothing from the wallet is sent.

@deskSetPrivUseStatusHint.description: Settings > Privacy: hint under the status site switch. status.btlabs.uk is a web address and stays.
